To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we propose a novel framework for multi channel speaker verification that combines advancements in multi channel speech enhancement, Voice Activity Detection, spectral, spatial, directional features and contrastive learning.

(1) multi channel features are useful for speaker verification, (2) multi channel speech enhancement can be beneficial for speaker verification, and (3) contrastive loss based fine-tuning can be used to further improve multi channel speaker verification.
We show that multi channel speaker features can improve robustness in far-field scenario.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a comprehensive study on multi channel features for robust far field speaker verification.
exploring various multi channel feature representations, and their combination with speech enhancement and VAD for robust far field Speaker Verification.
a comprehensive study on how to leverage multi channel features for robust speaker verification.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
multi channel features are very useful for speaker verification and can be used to achieve state of the art performance on challenging noisy conditions.
the multi channel features proposed in the paper are a valuable addition to single channel features, especially for noisy conditions.
our proposed system achieves a relative 40% reduction in EER w.r.t. a single channel system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed multi channel features and fine-tuning scheme are beneficial for speaker verification in noisy and reverberant environments.
the proposed framework can be easily adapted to any multi channel speaker embedding system and is a promising direction for further improvements.
the proposed multi channel feature combination is a simple yet powerful approach that is able to leverage supervised learning for multi channel speaker verification.
The main takeaway from our work is that
multi channel speech features can be used in a plug-and-play fashion to improve single channel speaker embedding space.
multi channel features can be combined with a single channel baseline in a simple and effective manner to improve performance in challenging far field scenario.
multi channel speaker features can be combined in a simple and flexible way to obtain robust far field speaker verification.
